notes.title: New Game Modes Added
notes.content:
Drawing Mode
Available in Singleplayer and Online Multiplayer

Create art directly on your desktop.
Non-blocking interaction with your operating system.
(This feature may be adjusted in future updates.)

Party Mode
Available in Online Multiplayer

 No rules, infinite pixels, socialize and fool around.

Stay tuned for more new features soon.

notes.title: Beta Branch Update
notes.content: The drawing game mode is now available for online multiplayer.

notes.title: Beta Branch Update
notes.content:
The new drawing singleplayer game mode has been enhanced with the following improvements:

 An eraser tool has been added for better editing capabilities.
 Drawn pixels are now bolder for improved visibility and clarity.

notes.title: Beta Branch Now Available
notes.content:
The beta branch of the game is now available.
You can switch to the beta branch to test new features and provide feedback.

What's New
Singleplayer Drawing Mode
A new game mode where you can draw directly on the screen.

To switch to the beta branch on Steam
[olist]
 Open your Steam Library.
 Right-click on the game title and select "Properties".
 Go to the "Betas" tab.
 In the drop-down menu, select "beta".
 Wait for the update to download.
[/olist]
